acceptedAnswer.text: Both target body fat and skin, but with different physics. CoolSculpting freezes fat (cryolipolysis). TightSculpting uses heat — laser energy that warms the adipose layer and contracts collagen at the same time. It is well suited for patients who want both tightening and fat reduction in one protocol.

mainEntity.name: How many sessions until I see change?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most patients begin to see change after 2 sessions. Full results develop over 8 to 12 weeks as collagen reorganises and the body removes the treated fat cells through normal metabolism. A full protocol is typically 4 sessions.

Minimal. Mild redness and warmth in the treated area are normal for a few hours. You can return to normal activity the same day. We recommend avoiding intense sun exposure on the treated area for a few days and using sunscreen as part of normal care.

hero.title: Fotona TightSculpting in Miami
hero.lede: TightSculpting combines Fotona's PIANO Nd:YAG sub-dermal heating with Er:YAG fractional resurfacing to tighten body skin and reduce localised fat without needles.

blocks.title: What it does for you
list: Tightens lax body skin on the abdomen, flanks, arms and inner thighs.
Reduces localised fat through controlled hyperthermia of the adipose layer.
Improves skin texture and tone in the same session as the tightening protocol.
Non-invasive — no liposuction, no needles, no incisions.
Each session lasts 45–90 minutes depending on the area; protocol typically 4 sessions spaced 2–4 weeks apart.
Pairs naturally with endolaser, lymphatic drainage or mesotherapy in a body programme.
